g.title: AC_PLUG
g.text: Incoming cord or cable feeding the fused inlet.

g.title: FI1
g.text: Bussmann: 3A fuse fitted where load calculation permits
Neutral and PE are shown as pass-through loops. Line output is the fused side of the inlet and then passes through CB1 before the line terminal.

g.title: CB1
g.text: Size to conductor and connected load. Do not use as PE or neutral switch.

g.title: TB_L
g.text: Electric split DIN rail terminal block

g.title: TB_N
g.text: User-described neutral block feeding both power supplies.

g.title: TB_PE
g.text: Attached to conductive enclosure/case. Keep PE continuous and low impedance.

g.title: SSR1
g.text: line-side switching for display power supply

Load side switches only the hot/line feed to the LRS-150F display PSU. Control side is shown from GPIO20. Verify SSR input rating; add driver transistor/opto interface if the module is not Pi-GPIO compatible.

g.title: PSU_DISPLAY
g.text: Condensed schematic view of LRS-150F terminals. Official unit has duplicated AC/L and AC/N terminals.

g.title: W_DISPLAY_DC_IN
g.text: LRS-150F to DC fuse block input

g.title: PSU_AON
g.text: 5 V, 10 A, always-on Pi/UPS power supply
Official LRS-50 terminal order is -V, +V, FG, AC/L, AC/N.

g.title: CASE_STUD
g.text: Scrape paint/anodizing under bonding hardware where required.

g.title: W_X1201_PWR
g.text: 6 in USB-C / 5 V UPS input lead
Use a cable/termination rated for the X1201 input current.

g.title: X1201
g.text: Raspberry Pi 5 UPS with Samsung 30Q cells
X1201 input requires 5 V at 5 A or greater. PLD is documented in the Conway controller as HIGH with wall power present and LOW on wall-power loss.

g.title: W_X1201_TO_PI
g.text: X1201 to Pi pogo/GPIO link representation
Physical power is via X1201 pogo pins; PLD lands on GPIO6 per verified repo configuration.

g.title: RPI_GPIO
g.text: GeeekPi GPIO screw terminal on Raspberry Pi 5
Buttons pull LOW to GND. Relay control is active high.

g.title: BAT1
g.text: Use only cells compatible with X1201 battery requirements.

g.title: BAT2
g.text: Install matched cells as required by the X1201.

g.title: STOP_BTN
g.text: Press connects GPIO19 to GND. STOP turns display side off; it does not halt the Pi.

g.title: FB1
g.text: Blue Sea Systems 5025 ST blade fuse block
6 circuits with negative bus and cover
Positive loops represent fused branch outputs inside the fuse block.

g.title: LED_LOADS
g.text: LED panel and NovaStar receiver power landing
Update branch count when final panel/power-lead count is confirmed.

g.title: NOVASTAR_TX
g.text: DVI input, RJ45 LED data output
Sender/receiver mapping must be preserved with the display package.

g.title: W_NOVASTAR_CAT
g.text: 10 Gb / Cat6 Ethernet cable used as NovaStar data link

g.title: W_HDMI_DVI
g.text: Duttek slim micro HDMI + CableCreation HDMI-to-DVI link
Represents micro HDMI to DVI signal chain from Pi to NovaStar sender.

g.title: W_SERVICE_ETH
g.text: UGreen Ethernet extension cable for direct service SSH

g.title: SERVICE_JACK
g.text: Direct service Ethernet path documented as Mac 10.55.0.1 to Pi 10.55.0.2.
